text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 02, 2026) for 101 Cosburn Avenue, 806.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Rescinded Item numbers 1 and 3 of the Property Standards Order, dated April 2, 2026, for 101 Cosburn Avenue, 806, Folder No. 26 136988 PRS 00 IV. 2. Confirmed and combined Items 2 and 4 of the Property Standards Order, dated April 2, 2026, for 101 Cosburn Avenue, 806, Folder No. 26 136988 PRS 00 IV for the following areas identified in the Structek report of April 20, 2026 that are located at 8, 9, 11 through 14 (Disclosure SZ43.4.4 - page 22 of 41) to comply with standards set out by ASTM F710-22 and Chapter 629-26.C., and in doing so grant an extension of time to October 30, 2026.
